text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Finance Minister Aleke Banda has moved to reassure supporters of his ruling United Democratic Front in the north of the country over a looming merger between the opposition Malawi Congress Party (MCP) and the Alliance for Democacy.
- The MCP has asked the police inspector-general to hand over copies of files and statements from three polling stations where electoral offences were recorded in byelections in May.
- A police officer in Lilongwe has been suspended after being identified as a prime suspect in the illegal supply of firearms to a gang terrorising the capital city.
- The government plans increased sexual health publicity campaigns.
- President Bakili Muluzi was shocked to hear that some teachers in Blantyre had still not been paid a month after he ordered the education ministry to pay all of them, his spokesman said.
